mapper.select: SELECT t.bucket AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 10 THEN '0-10' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 20 THEN '10-20' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 30 THEN '20-30' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 40 THEN '30-40' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 50 THEN '40-50' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 60 THEN '50-60' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 70 THEN '60-70' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 80 THEN '70-80' WHEN cr.repeat_rate < 90 THEN '80-90' ELSE '90-100' END AS bucket FROM check_result cr WHERE cr.is_deleted = 0 AND cr.repeat_rate IS NOT NULL ) t GROUP BY t.bucket

SELECT pi.college_id AS collegeId, c.college_name AS collegeName, ROUND(AVG(pi.similarity_rate), 2) AS avgRate, COUNT(*) AS total FROM paper_info pi LEFT JOIN college c ON pi.college_id = c.id WHERE pi.is_deleted = 0 AND pi.similarity_rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pi.college_id, c.college_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cr.check_time, '%Y-%m') AS ym, COUNT(*) AS count, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(cr.repeat_rate), 2), 0) AS avgRate FROM check_result cr WHERE cr.is_deleted = 0 AND cr.check_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cr.check_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY ym
